articles.title: LIC gains 3% after Q1 earnings. Here's what Morgan Stanley and Motilal Oswal recommend
articles.content: LIC shares rose 2.5% after the state-owned insurer reported a 23% year-on-year jump in Q1 standalone net profit to Rs 13,492 crore, while net premium income grew 7% to Rs 1.27 lakh crore. LIC also retained its leadership in the domestic life insurance market, with a 60.1% share of first-year premium income, according to IRDAI data.

articles.title: Dalal Street's biggest stock reform in years endures rocky first week
articles.content: India's recently introduced closing auction system for stock prices is encountering early challenges, with traders raising alarms over erratic price fluctuations and confusion in the marketplace. In response, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) held discussions with brokerages, reassuring them of the system's persistence. The lack of engagement from proprietary and high-frequency traders resulted in decreased liquidity, potentially affecting broker revenues and the volume of derivatives trading.

articles.title: Sensex drops over 200 points, Nifty tests 23,600 as Strait of Hormuz tensions rattle oil markets
articles.content: Indian stock markets opened lower on Friday as oil prices increased. Concerns over Iran potentially closing the Strait of Hormuz impacted investor sentiment. Bajaj Finance and Bajaj Finserv shares led the declines on the Sensex. IT stocks like TCS and Tech Mahindra bucked the trend with gains. Analysts suggest market consolidation is likely before an eventual upside breakout.

articles.title: FII exodus! Top 10 stocks which saw sharpest decline in foreign capital in Q1. See full list
articles.content: Foreign institutional investors have markedly scaled back their holdings in various Indian firms. Notably, Piramal Pharma faced the steepest decline, with FII ownership plummeting by 17.7 percentage points. RBL Bank also saw a significant drop of 11.4 percentage points. Other companies such as Indraprastha Gas and Rail Vikas Nigam experienced similar FII divestments, indicating a trend of foreign capital withdrawal.

articles.title: SBI Q1 results preview: Will India's largest public bank report a decline in profit?
articles.content: In the upcoming June quarter, State Bank of India's profits are projected to dip, influenced by margin constraints and a slowdown in income growth. Analysts foresee a decrease in net interest margins despite vigorous loan activity. With deposit growth expected to trail behind credit expansion, this could prevent any recovery in margins, though asset quality seems likely to remain stable with consistent credit expenditures.

articles.title: Swiggy’s ₹60,000 crore breakeven challenge: Can Instamart grow without restarting the cash war?
articles.content: Swiggy's Instamart is targeting an impressive ₹60,000 crore in annualised net order value to achieve profitability. To reach this goal, the platform must double its current orders and enhance contribution margins significantly. This means Instamart should aim to garner an additional ₹30 per order through various optimizations. However, the competitive advantage of Blinkit's size and profitability poses a formidable challenge amid the ongoing balancing act of growth and economic recovery.
